# A round bush for the far bank: three faceted balls. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name A --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0.45
add mesh ico-sphere --name B --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0.5 0.1 0.35
add mesh ico-sphere --name C --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.38 --location -0.45 0.05 0.32
material new Leaf --base-color 0.145 0.443 0.475
select A B C
material assign Leaf
add mesh ico-sphere --name F0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location 0.1 -0.5 0.62
add mesh ico-sphere --name F1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location 0.6 -0.32 0.45
add mesh ico-sphere --name F2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location -0.4 -0.33 0.48
material new Flower --base-color 0.957 0.957 0.957
select F0 F1 F2
material assign Flower
select all
shade flat
export bush.glb
